stem.en: The cell membrane is made of proteins and lipids. Put the path of these materials in order, from where they are made to the membrane.

text.en: The ER makes proteins and lipids.
The Golgi apparatus modifies and sorts them.
A vesicle joins the cell membrane.

explanation.en: Proteins are made on rough ER and lipids on smooth ER. The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts and packages them into vesicles, and the vesicles join the cell membrane.

hints.en: Start where the materials are made.
